files.content: # Run and deploy your AI Studio app This contains everything you need to run your app locally. View your app in AI Studio: https://ai.studio/apps/cfbc1511-e1c6-486a-bd15-84959ecb588b ## Run Locally **Prerequisites:** Node.js 1. Install dependencies: `npm install` 2. Set the `GEMINI_API_KEY` in [.env.local](.env.local) to your Gemini API key 3. Run the app: `npm run dev`

GEMINI_API_KEY="your-gemini-api-key-here"
DEEPSEEK_API_KEY="your-deepseek-api-key-here"

{
  "name": "react-example",
  "private": true,
  "version": "0.0.0",
  "type": "module",
  "scripts": {
    "dev": "tsx server.ts",
    "build": "vite build && esbuild server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --packages=external --sourcemap --outfile=dist/server.cjs",
    "start": "node dist/server.cjs",
    "clean": "rm -rf dist server.js",
    "lint": "tsc --noEmit"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "@google/genai": "^2.4.0",
    "@react-three/drei": "^10.7.7",

    "react": "^19.0.1",

    "vite": "^6.2.3",
    "zustand": "^5.0.14"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@types/express": "^4.17.21",
    "@types/node": "^22.14.0",
    "autoprefixer": "^10.4.21",
    "esbuild": "^0.25.0",
    "tailwindcss": "^4.1.14",
    "tsx": "^4.21.0",
    "typescript": "~5.8.2",
    "vite": "^6.2.3"
  }
}
